content.title: Ebay login verification has stopped working and reverts users to a alternate browser - Browser Support / Desktop Support - Brave Community
content.text: post by Phil_Indeblanc on Feb 7, 2020 Description of the issue: How can this issue be reproduced? Once you are already logged into Ebay, when promting to contact a seller, a verification login pops up, and even after user/pw it opens this page message: Please verify yourself to continue To keep eBay a safe place to buy and sell, we will occasionally ask you to verify yourself. This helps us to block unauthorized users from entering our site. Please verify yourself If you are having difficulties with rendering of images on the above verification page, eBay suggests using the latest version of your browser, or an alternate browser listed in [here] I also do not have scripts blocked. Expected result: I should not have to remove device blocking, nor cross link checks to have this site function. Brave Version( check About Brave): 1.243 Additional Information: Will this be a new trend for sites? post by fanboynz on Feb 7, 2020 Hey @Phil_Indeblanc Can you try a couple of things; Allow all cookies in Shields (in the address bar) Then logout and re-login again to Ebay. If this doesn’t work, let me know. Not sure how to test this without buying something Closed on Mar 8, 2020 This topic was automatically closed 30 days after the last reply. New replies are no longer allowed.
